name: Karaya Gum
aliases: E416, karaya gum, gum karaya, gum sterculia, Sterculia gum, kadaya, karaya, katilo, kullo, kuterra
what_is: A plant gum obtained from Sterculia species and used mainly as a stabiliser, thickener and emulsifier.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E416 is a texture-modifying additive and the label does not normally disclose botanical batch, processing or concentration.
can_1: Identify E416, karaya gum or Sterculia gum when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount used when no quantitative declaration is provided.
cannot_2: Determine the exact Sterculia source species, processing method or purity profile from the ingredient name alone.

sources.label: FDA — Substances Added to Food database
